verdict.rationale: Lago ships a full REST API with an OpenAPI schema and generated CLI commands for every endpoint, is self-hostable via Docker, and its GitHub repo includes a script that spins up a disposable local organization for scripted usage — all of which support headless/CI automation. However there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, dedicated CLI tool for automation testing, or first-party guidance on running it inside CI systems. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline docs/examples, a dedicated automation CLI tool, independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI usage.
